title: The Honest Math — $5,000 a Month Is ~$4,500

intelligence.essence: Shawn handed Resolve the Bugatti founding-letter draft and asked for a scorecard for its job: closing the page, highest conversion + understanding. She scored the raw founder material 9/10 — but as a finished page-closer 6/10 — and filed a 10x rewrite alongside the scorecard. The rewrite keeps his gold lines verbatim, cuts ~40%, stacks the close in canon order (nine days full power → hired at 50% → Academy free → stay free forever), moves privacy up, ends on ONE button. The honesty correction inside it: "$5,000 a month for the rest of your life" needs the top tier plus perfect retention forever to be true. Her rewrite shows the real math instead: 3 a day × 30 days = 90 members × $50 = ~$4,500 a month while they stay. The same line sits in the letter's beat 8 right now — the correction belongs there too.
intelligence.human_view: Resolve's scores, as presented to Shawn 00:10Z: raw words 9/10; as a finished page-closer 6/10. Her correction, in the captain's words to Shawn: "your '$5,000 a month for the rest of your life' needs the top tier plus perfect retention forever to be true. Her rewrite shows the real math instead — three a day, thirty days, ninety members at $50, about $4,500 a month while they stay. That's the same line sitting in the letter's beat 8 right now, so the fix belongs there too."
intelligence.child_view: Imagine telling a friend, "If you do this, you'll get five thousand dollars every month forever." But that only works if every single person stays forever and nobody ever leaves — and people always leave sometimes. The honest way to say it is: "Three people a day, for a month, is ninety people — at fifty dollars each, that's about four thousand five hundred a month, for as long as they stay." Same dream, true numbers.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a big round number is tempting, but if it only works when nobody ever leaves, it isn't honest. The rewrite keeps his beautiful words and simply does the sums properly: ninety people staying, fifty dollars each, about four and a half thousand a month. The dream is the same size — the numbers just tell the truth now.
intelligence.ai_view: The 9/10 and the 6/10 are not a contradiction — they are two different jobs. The raw words are gold; the shape they were poured into does not close. A scorecard that praises the words and fails the shape is the honest one, and the rewrite that keeps the gold lines verbatim while cutting 40% is the proof: nothing precious was lost, only the weight around it. The $5,000 line is the same lesson at the level of a single number — a claim that needs forever-perfect retention is a claim that will be found out by the first month it isn't true, and "while they stay" is the three words that make it honest. The letter's beat 8 carries the same line, so the correction is owed in two places, not one.
